wiringAudit.scope: source inspection and focused local contract tests; no service or datastore probes

layers.name: canonical_store
evidence: PostgreSQL/pgvector are documented canonical owners in repository guidance
gaps: No database query or current source-to-packet readback was performed in this audit

layers.name: parsing_and_transport
gaps: SIMDJSON bridge accepts JSON strings and may fall back to JSON.parse; zero-copy is not established
No MsgPack-to-live-owner IPC path was demonstrated

layers.name: packet_class_lut
evidence: sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/atlas/residency/packet-class-lut-v1.ts explicitly defines a derived presentation/compression view
gaps: Module documentation says packet/cache wiring is not present here

layers.name: multi_lane_retrieval
evidence: sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/retrieval/search-runtime.ts owns fusion and invokes the canonical rerank executor
gaps: The reported function-registry retriever is not registered in a production SearchRuntime caller
A current end-to-end FTS/BM42/Qdrant/RRF/rerank replay was not run

layers.name: classifier_and_routing
gaps: No evidence in this audit that the HMM owns SearchRuntime budget routing
Logistic-regression production reranking was not established

layers.name: graph_traversal
gaps: The cited 0.043 ms scan was not independently reproduced
No revision-qualified 1-hop/2-hop function traversal was run

layers.name: cache_warming
gaps: The warm plan is proposal-only and adds no cache write or retrieval vote
No Redis/Valkey readback or cold/warm parity was tested

layers.name: orchestration_and_tools
gaps: The pipeline descriptor is a read-only contract and no production caller to ACP was found in the scoped source review
No MCP function-registry or cache.warm_plan registration was proven

focusedTests.command: cd sveltekit-frontend && npx vitest run --config vitest.lane-contracts.config.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 src/lib/server/atlas/pipeline/unified-context-pipeline-v1.spec.ts src/lib/server/atlas/transport/messagepack-transport-v1.spec.ts src/lib/server/atlas/residency/packet-class-lut-v1.spec.ts src/lib/server/atlas/cache/bitfrost-token-fsm-v1.spec.ts src/lib/server/gpu/simdjson-bridge.spec.ts src/lib/server/ai/acp-rpc-loop.spec.ts
focusedTests.requestedDedicatedSpecNotFound: messagepack-transport-v1.spec.ts; transport behavior is exercised by multi-plane-execution.spec.ts

additionalFocusedTests.command: cd sveltekit-frontend && npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 src/lib/server/atlas/residency/multi-plane-execution.spec.ts src/lib/server/gpu/simdjson-bridge.spec.ts src/lib/server/ai/acp-rpc-loop.spec.ts

wiringAudit.promotion: Do not treat source presence or fixture tests as proof of end-to-end pipeline wiring.
